about_the_game:
Welcome to Vibe City Islands Architect! Design and build the your island paradise in this tiny indie city-building game.

  • Create Your Dream City: Build a thriving city across picturesque islands surrounded by the ocean.

  • High Score Mode: Take on 4 important city objectives: Housing, Jobs, Parks, and Tourism. Unlock and place 40 new buildings per rank as you climb from a Rank 1 to Rank 5 Architect!

  • Sandbox Mode: Unleash your creativity with no budgets, targets, or restrictions—just pure building bliss. Find your favourite radio station or chill with ambiance.

  • Diverse Soundtrack: Jam out to various music genres with numerous radio stations to choose from. The game will launch 40 radio stations of carefully curated vibes. Dance/ pop/ 80s/ 60s/ rock/ metal/ lo-fi/ jazz/ synthwave/ liquid drum&bass/ techno/ k-pop/ salsa/ rap/ hip hop and more.. the radio stations will be one of the coolest parts of the game actually.

  • Customizable Living: Start with a humble home and upgrade to a luxurious mansion as you grow richer.

  • Island Adventures: Explore your city by driving around in a golf cart or upgrade to a sleek sports car for that extra style.

     

  • Instant Construction: Watch buildings rise instantly with mesmerizing blueprint effects.

  • Growing Population: Add life to your city as more citizens arrive with every new building.

  • Tropical Aesthetic for your first city: Experience a city-building adventure set in a vibrant, relaxing island paradise. A great way to relax and find your vibe.

  • Building variety: Each city will have 200 visually unique buildings/props matching the style and vibe of that city. Expand your city by building new platforms on water (Rank 3+ Architect needed in high score mode).

  • Multiple cities: the game will launch with 6 different city types (each city has a unique set of buildings/props), with a maximum of 34 cities added in the road map. Every radio station will have a home city.

Are you ready to design your masterpiece? Dive into the world of Vibe City Islands Architect and craft the city of your dreams! Or just chill and vibe.

This will be one of those small games for a nice price you can get immersed in within minutes. Get busy in the details of what your island city people need, then zoom out and marvel at your creation. Get in your car/cart, take a cruise around. Put the radio on, and if you don't like the station just build a new radio tower..

trailer song= Last stop "Music by Karl Casey @ White Bat Audio"
